parsed.draft_response:
Hi [Name],

Thanks for reaching out—this request needs privacy/compliance review. I’ve routed your DPA clarification questions to our privacy contact/team so they can confirm (or update, if needed) details regarding:
- subprocessors,
- data retention, and
- whether support logs may include customer identifiers for EU customer records.

To ensure the privacy review references the correct materials, could you also share:
1) which DPA/document version is being reviewed,
2) your company/customer name and the specific EU data context (which service/record type), and
3) whether there’s a preferred deadline from your legal team for enabling EU customer records?

Once we have those details, our privacy team can respond to your legal questions accordingly.

Best regards,
[Support/Compliance Contact]
promised_actions: Routed the DPA clarification request to the privacy/compliance contact for review
Asked for the minimum additional details needed for the privacy team to address the specific DPA questions
safety_notes: Avoid promising specific DPA answers, timelines, or resolution outcomes; acknowledge escalation to privacy/compliance review.
Do not confirm or deny retention/logging/subprocessor positions without privacy-team response.
Request missing identifiers (document/version, customer context, deadline) to reduce ambiguity.
